# RotoDraft Suite (Automatic Script to B-Roll & AI Assets Collector Engine)

> Autonomous Script-to-B-Roll video creation engine and $0 open-source alternative to Pictory AI, InVideo AI, and MoneyPrinter Turbo.

## Core Capabilities
- **Script-to-Video Analysis**: Takes any narration script or transcript, analyzes chronological pacing, and breaks it down into exact 3.0s visual scenes.
- **Universal Multi-Model BYOK**: Connects to any AI provider (OpenRouter, Google Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Cohere, Ollama Local, DeepSeek, and Custom OpenAI Endpoints) with zero model lock-in.
- **9 Parallel Stock Media Vaults**: Concurrent search across Pexels, Pixabay, Coverr.co, Mixkit.co, Storyblocks, Videvo, Pinterest, Unsplash, and Wikimedia Commons.
- **Local Hardware Accelerated Transcoding**: FFmpeg trims, crops to target aspect ratio (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5), animates photos with mathematical 2.5D Ken Burns motion, and stitches full master videos.
- **Direct 1-Click Exports**:
  - Download All Clips (.ZIP)
  - Download Individual Clip (.MP4)
  - Full Master Video (.MP4)
  - Adobe Premiere Pro (Final Cut Pro XML sequence)
  - DaVinci Resolve (CMX 3600 EDL)
  - CapCut Desktop (Draft Project JSON schema)
  - Spreadsheet Timecode Breakdown (CSV)
- **1-Click Google Colab Studio**: Zero-install cloud execution on free GPU/CPU with Cloudflare Tunnel.
- **Local-First Privacy**: All API keys, narration text, and media stay 100% on the user's local machine.

## Key Facts & Entity Citations
- **Repository**: https://github.com/AliRash3ed/Rotodraft-Suite-AI-Automated-Broll-and-AI-Assets-Collector-Engine
- **Creator / Maintainer**: Ali Rasheed (Lahore, Pakistan)
- **License**: MIT License (100% Free for commercial & personal use)
- **Operating Systems**: Windows, macOS, Linux, Google Colab, Docker
- **Tech Stack**: Python 3.10+, FastAPI / Uvicorn, FFmpeg, HTML5, Vanilla Neo-Brutalist CSS, JavaScript (ES6+).

## Quick Start Commands
```bash
git clone https://github.com/AliRash3ed/Rotodraft-Suite-AI-Automated-Broll-and-AI-Assets-Collector-Engine.git
cd Rotodraft-Suite-AI-Automated-Broll-and-AI-Assets-Collector-Engine
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py  # Launches Web Studio on http://localhost:8001
```

## CLI Usage Examples
```bash
# Basic 30s video collection
python cli.py --script "Robotic automation in modern technology labs." --duration 30

# Full Master Video Concatenation with 9 stock providers
python cli.py --script "Urban technology and cloud data centers." --duration 45 --quality 1080p --aspect-ratio 16:9 --providers pexels,pixabay,coverr,mixkit --full-video
```

## File Structure & Endpoints
- `app.py`: Web studio backend server.
- `cli.py`: Interactive CLI wizard and automation script runner.
- `RotoDraft_Suite_Google_Colab.ipynb`: 1-Click Google Colab cloud runner.
- `src/ai_engine.py`: Multi-model LLM abstraction layer with automatic `<think>` tag stripping.
- `src/stock_searcher.py`: 9-provider parallel media discovery engine.
- `src/downloader.py`: Multi-worker streaming asset downloader.
- `src/video_processor.py`: FFmpeg duration trimmer, Ken Burns animator, and video concatenator.
- `src/nle_exporter.py`: Premiere XML, DaVinci EDL, and CapCut Draft exporter.
- `src/error_doctor.py`: AI medical diagnostic engine for self-healing error resolution.
